title: github.create_issue
description: File a gap as a GitHub issue on the configured repo (env AETHER_GITHUB_REPO, default ashwinsreedhar28/Aether) — with dedup INSIDE the surface. The node first checks an in-process memo of keys it already filed (GitHub's filtered list is eventually consistent; back-to-back re-asks must still dedup — memo hits are re-verified open via a direct read), then searches open 'gap'-labeled issues for a matching normalized capability key; on either match it comments the new utterance on the existing issue (the +1 demand signal) and returns { ok, deduped: true, number, url, comment_id, capability_key } — no duplicate is filed. Otherwise it creates the issue (title 'gap(<area>): <summary>', label 'gap', body carrying the verbatim utterance, attempted path/failure, session id, timestamp, and a machine-readable capability-key marker) and returns { ok, deduped: false, number, url, capability_key }. Gap issues are RECORDS, not contracts — no spec content in the body. capability_key is optional; when absent it is derived from area + summary (normalized: lowercase, non-alphanumerics to hyphens). Denies: github_no_token (AETHER_GITHUB_TOKEN absent — the degraded capability error), github_bad_capability_key (nothing survives normalization), github_api_error { status, reason }, github_unreachable { reason }.
